description: Use to start a Watch + Alert on one Solana token, not for a one-shot check (use rug_check, token_safety, or honeypot_check for those). hours=24 costs $0.05 (5 credits); hours=48 costs $0.10 (10 credits); hours defaults to 24. Re-checked about every 10 min; signed webhook alert when the dev sells, liquidity drops 30%+, mint/freeze authority appears, risk score jumps 20+ points, or it can't be sold. Each call starts a new paid watch (not idempotent) and returns watchId, expiry, and destination. To see or stop watches started with your credit key, use list_watches or cancel_watch. Pass a RugRadar credit key (api_key or header X-RugRadar-Key); without one the tool returns the x402 payment requirement for GET /watch. telegram_chat_id is not available yet — use webhook_url for signed JSON POST alerts. Invalid or failed creates are not charged. No free daily check on this tool.

telegram_chat_id.description: Telegram chat id (not available yet; use webhook_url)

token.description: Solana mint address (this tool is Solana only)

webhook_url.description: https URL for signed JSON POST alerts

name: watch_token

outputSchema.description: Success fields on a paid/authorized call, or error/payment_required fields. Additional properties may be present.

error.description: payment_required, bad_input, or a failure code

payWith.description: x402 payment requirement for the HTTP route, plus credit-key instructions when those apply

priceUsd.description: USDC price to pay when error is payment_required

refunded.description: true when a credit was taken and then returned because the call failed

title: Start Token Watch + Alert
